summary: Members of Council may file petitions.
decided: City Council on March 27 and 28, 2019, received the following petition for information: 1. Petition headed "Save our Subway", submitted by Councillor Josh Matlow, Ward 12, Toronto-St. Paul's, containing the names of approximately 3,868 persons.
text: Members of Council may file petitions.

City Council on March 27 and 28, 2019, received the following petition for information: 1. Petition headed "Save our Subway", submitted by Councillor Josh Matlow, Ward 12, Toronto-St. Paul's, containing the names of approximately 3,868 persons.
